WEBSITE.TITLE: Start with your website
WEBSITE.DESCRIPTION: Your AI agent reads it and answers your customers from it. You can continue right away.
WEBSITE.LABEL: Website address
WEBSITE.INVALID: Enter a website address like example.com.
WEBSITE.FINDING: {count} page found so far. This usually takes a minute or two. | {count} pages found so far. This usually takes a minute or two.
WEBSITE.READING: {ready} of {total} pages ready. You can continue; the rest are read in the background.
WEBSITE.DONE: {ready} page imported. Your AI agent answers from it. | {ready} pages imported. Your AI agent answers from them.
WEBSITE.SOME_FAILED: {count} page couldn't be read. | {count} pages couldn't be read.
WEBSITE.EMPTY_BODY: Choose pages yourself in Knowledge, or try another address.
WEBSITE.FAILED_BODY: Check that the address is right and the site is public, then try again.
WEBSITE.IMPORT_FAILED: The pages couldn't be imported. Try again.

TEST.TITLE: Meet your AI agent
TEST.DESCRIPTION: It already knows the pages it has read. Ask what a customer would ask; nothing you type here reaches a customer.
TEST.NO_AGENT: Add your website first, so the AI agent has something to answer from.

LIVE.TITLE: Go live
LIVE.DESCRIPTION: It answers visitors in your website chat. Your team can take over any conversation.
LIVE.KNOWLEDGE_IMPORTING: Pages are still being read. It answers from the ready ones.
LIVE.NO_KNOWLEDGE: No knowledge yet. Add your website first.
LIVE.INBOX_NEW: A website chat will be created

INSTALL.TITLE: Add the chat to your website
INSTALL.DESCRIPTION: Paste this code before the closing body tag on every page, or into your site builder's custom code setting.
INSTALL.NO_INBOX: Turn the AI agent on first. That creates your website chat.

RESULT.INSTALLED: The chat runs on your website.
RESULT.SCRIPT_FOUND: Found the code on {site}. It shows as installed after the first visit.
RESULT.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find the code on {site}. If you add it with a tag manager, open your site once and check again.
RESULT.UNREACHABLE: We couldn't open {site}. Check that it is public.
RESULT.ERROR: The check didn't finish. Try again.

GUIDED.LEARNING_MORE: Still reading the rest in the background. You don't need to wait.

CHAT.TEST_ONLY: Test chat. Nothing here reaches a customer.
CHAT.ERROR: Your AI agent couldn't answer just now. Try again.
CHAT.EMPTY: Ask your AI agent something a customer would ask.
